name: ABC Legal
desc:
Docketly - Court Coverage Specialist | $20 to $22/hr | Outbound Calls, Texts, and Email, Fee Negotiation, No Commission
Company: Docketly (sister company to ABC Legal Services)
Industry: Law and Legal Services

What Your Day Will Look Like:
When a law firm needs an attorney in court on short notice, Docketly makes it happen, and you're the person who gets it done. Think of yourself as part dispatcher, part deal maker, and part go-to contact. You'll own a list of upcoming court hearings and work the phones, texts, and email to line up an attorney for each one before the deadline. You'll negotiate fees in real time, handle last-minute changes and cancellations, and keep law firms updated so they're never surprised. You'll welcome new attorneys to the network and be the friendly voice that keeps them saying yes. Every day ends with a clear scoreboard of hearings covered, and you'll help the team spot gaps and make things run better in daily huddles. It's fast, it's never boring, and there's a real promotion ladder for people who shine.

Soft Skills
- Confident, friendly phone presence
- Staying calm and decisive under deadlines
- Negotiation and persistence
- Organization with many open items
- Problem solving on the fly
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment after applying or after initial contact with recruiter
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: At least 1 year in a job with high-volume phone outreach or negotiation, like inside sales, account management, collections, dispatch, scheduling, or high-touch customer service
Preferred Experience: Staffing, dispatch, gig-platform operations, or outbound call center work, hitting KPIs, CRM or scheduling tools, legal or collections exposure, and Mac OS and Google Workspace

Required Skills:
- Comfortable and efficient on the phone
- Strong verbal and written communication
- Very organized with many open items at once
- Calm and decisive under deadline pressure
- Quick to learn new technology

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has done dispatch, scheduling, collections, or busy call center work
- Loves a scoreboard and a goal to beat
- Enjoys negotiating and getting to yes
- Wants steady $20+ pay with no commission and a path to promotion

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Doesn't like making outbound calls
- Would rather not be measured on daily numbers
- Gets flustered by last-minute changes
- Has less than a year of phone-heavy or negotiation work
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Dispatch and scheduling
- High-volume outbound calls
- Negotiation
- Account management
- Pipeline management
- Meeting KPIs
- CRM data entry
- Client communication
- Problem solving under deadlines
- Collections or legal operations

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your experience with high-volume phone outreach or negotiation.
- A hearing is tomorrow and the attorney just canceled. What do you do?
- How do you keep track of dozens of open items without letting any slip?
- Tell us about a time you negotiated to get to yes. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you beat a goal or metric at work. What was the goal, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $20 to $22/hr, based on experience. No commission, just steady hourly pay.
-Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain (9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Central).
-Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, PTO, 7 paid company holidays, 4 floating holidays, life and AD&D insurance, long-term disability, FSA and dependent care FSA, EAP, and pet insurance.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: OMMA friendly
-Notes: The posting lists this as remote for Oklahoma. It's a great fit for participants with dispatch, scheduling, collections, or busy call center experience who want $20+ pay without commission. Docketly promotes from within, with a clear path to senior specialist and supervisor. The work is outbound and measured on daily numbers, so make sure participants are comfortable with that. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Court Coverage Specialist → Senior Coverage Specialist → Coverage Supervisor → Operations Manager. This role builds dispatch, negotiation, and account management skills.
